view.summary: An endless maze run: swipe through the corridors collecting coins and items, dodge Shadows and outrun the collapsing map while your HP drains.

overview.title: How it plays
items: Swipe (or WASD / arrow keys) to pick a direction; your character runs until she hits a wall, then waits for the next input.
You start with 900 HP. It drains steadily (faster at higher difficulty), and each enemy you run into takes 300 HP (the enemy is destroyed). After a hit you are invincible for 1 s.
After a while (start delay 5 s) the map collapses from behind and follows you; touching it ends the run, as does reaching 0 HP.
200 points per metre, 750 per enemy defeated with an item or skill, coin points and combo bonuses.
Coins and treasure chests fill a skill gauge; when it is full the character’s Persona skill fires by itself.

overview.title: Combo bonus
overview.note: Pick up items one after another without the timer running out (or getting hit). Each milestone raises the combo level and pays a bonus; after the last one the combo starts over.
